_readme: Settings for one video. Keys starting with _ are notes. Anything left out falls back to the defaults in nightshift/project.py.
name: starter

comfy._dir: Path to the ComfyUI folder when ComfyUI runs on this machine (the one with input/ and output/). Leave null when ComfyUI is on another machine: files are uploaded and downloaded over its API.

takes._complex: shots marked "complex": true (singing + dancing + a camera move) get best-of-4

sheets._sheets: character sheets are made first. approve: stop to approve the looks even in yolo mode (false = fully unattended). yolo_source: text = yolo builds sheets from the written description; image = from the character's reference picture when there is one

_song_voices: e.g. ["female"] when the chosen song has no second singer: shots with "voice": "male" fall back to their fallback_mode

overlay._enabled: true to render the HUD overlay (needs node + npm; see docs/overlay.md)
